resources.string: Go through the introduction and the quick setup again
Your settings, widgets and layout are back. zrAuto has to restart for them to take effect; tap the button and it opens again by itself.
Your car deserves a better media player. Here is a quick look at what it does, then a minute of setup to make it yours.
Plays your music, videos and YouTube, even when the signal doesn\'t
Made for Android Auto, and for your steering wheel\'s buttons
Free, open source, no donation nagging
Download videos, playlists or just the audio. They play right inside your lists, with no signal at all.
Downloads carry on in the background and pick up where they stopped
Signal gone mid-song? It switches to the downloaded copy without missing a beat
Send downloads to a friend\'s phone on the same Wi-Fi
Import a playlist or your Liked Songs, and zrAuto finds every song on YouTube for you.
Your latest liked songs, or all of them
Sync a playlist again whenever it changes
They land in playlists of your own, ready to play
Drive the whole app with your steering wheel\'s Previous and Next buttons, without touching the screen.
Previous and Next move a glowing outline; hold Next to open or play, hold Previous to go back
Works in your lists, YouTube search, the queue, menus and Settings
Only while Android Auto is connected
Lyrics scroll in time with the song. Tap them on the Music tab to open them full size, right there.
Tap a line to jump to it, drag to scroll through the song
Font, size, colour and alignment are yours to change
Sound the way you like it
A mixer-style Equalizer, Bass Boost, Virtualizer and reverb, for YouTube too.
Tune it per track or per folder
Playback speed per track or folder
Fades between songs and videos, so nothing ever cuts
One card of big tiles for what you reach for most while driving: the sleep timer, video quality, effects and more.
Open it from a floating button or a steering wheel key
You choose the tiles and their order
Rain, thunder, a fireplace, the ocean and more, playing softly behind your music or video.
Sixteen sounds, synthesized or from real recordings
Mix them, set the volume and a timer; it fades in and out
The weather is drawn behind the Music tab too
Power saver, power usage and lyrics are tiles too
A few things that make a long drive easier.
Data usage: what videos, music and downloads cost, with a limit and a warning
Power usage: the battery draw live like Ampere, a daily trend and a power saver
Share to a nearby phone, Fuel Log, Private Mode and a night mode for video
Back up, or bring it all back
Already have a backup? Restore it and everything comes back as it was. Otherwise, turn on automatic backups so your settings and playlists are never lost.
Pick the backup file with the system\'s file picker. Google Drive works there too. The app restarts once it is restored.
Saves a backup zip on its own
Will you use it in your car?
With Android Auto connected, zrAuto can follow your steering wheel and go easy on your battery and data. Say yes and we set that up next.
Android Auto and steering wheel keys
You can set the car up later under Settings > Key bindings and Settings > Interface > Android Auto.
The ones most people turn on first.
Previous and Next move an outline; hold Next to open
For cars that send Next and Previous as commands
More room on the car screen
Starts when Android Auto connects, and darkens the phone\'s screen
A warning when a drive uses more than you set
Open zrAuto from Android Auto\'s launcher on the car screen. Everything here is in Settings too.
Press a button on your steering wheel, or tap a key below, and see exactly what zrAuto gets and what it does. Tap and hold to try a long press.
On your steering wheel, or tap one below
With car mode on, Previous and Next move the outline on the car screen instead, and hold Next opens. These apply everywhere else.
A few more things worth switching on. Every one of them is in Settings later.
The bars tuck away while a list scrolls
On the Music tab, for songs that have them
A small info strip at the top right
Battery draw in the info strip
Dims the phone, holds 60 Hz and pauses downloads when it runs low
You get a warning at 80%, and a stop at the limit
Enjoy the drive. There is a lot more to tune in Settings, and this introduction is always under Settings > Other.
